verdict.rationale: Versioning, reviewing, and rolling back automations is a fair question for an AI-native design and workflow product, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no version history, change review, or rollback for automations or designs. Automatic design-system application, the multi-app workflow examples, and the remark that prototypes need "no code review" are adjacent features and do not deliver this capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
